components.name: Accordion
components.description: A stack of sections whose content expands and collapses under a heading, like an FAQ. Use with AccordionItem.

components.name: ActionButton
components.description: One button that handles the permission check, an optional confirmation, the pending state and a result message for an action. It does not fetch data, show toasts, cache or route: you pass the function that does the work.

components.name: AgentActivity
components.description: A short summary of what the assistant is doing or did, such as "Used 3 tools", that opens into each step. It stays open while a step needs approval.

components.name: AlertDialog
components.description: Confirmation dialog for destructive or irreversible actions. It cannot be dismissed by clicking outside, and can ask the user to type a word before the confirm button works. Open it with DialogTrigger.

components.name: Alert
components.description: An inline message about the state of the page or a task: a tip, a success, a warning or an error. For brief confirmations that disappear, use Toast.

components.name: AppFooter
components.description: The footer of an application or marketing page: a line of text, link lists and social links. It stacks on a phone and has the same size and spacing on every page.

components.name: ApprovalBox
components.description: Asks someone to approve or decline something the assistant wants to do. It says what will happen, how risky it is and whether it can be undone, in words as well as color.

components.name: AuthCard
components.description: The centered card for sign in, sign up, forgot password and verify code screens: a logo, a title, your form, other ways to sign in and links underneath.

components.name: AvatarGroup
components.description: An overlapping stack of avatars with a +N chip for the rest, for showing who is on a team, thread or file.

components.name: Avatar
components.description: A person's or account's picture, falling back to their initials when there is no image or it fails to load.

components.name: Badge
components.description: A small label that states a status or category, like Paid, Overdue or Beta. Not interactive.

components.name: BlurFade
components.description: Content that sharpens and slides into place when it first appears or when it scrolls into view. It is visible to start with, so it never hides content from anyone.

components.name: Breadcrumbs
components.description: The path from the top of the site to the current page, as links. Use BreadcrumbItem for each step; the last one is the current page.

components.name: Button
components.description: Triggers an action or event, such as submitting a form or opening a dialog.

components.name: Calendar
components.description: Month grid for picking a date. RangeCalendar picks a start and end. Used inside DatePicker and DateRangePicker.

components.name: Card
components.description: A container that groups related content under an optional heading. Compose it with media, an overlay, header, meta, actions, body, a footer and a coloured band for destination, profile, listing and detail-panel cards.

components.name: Chart
components.description: A bar, line, area or donut chart drawn in plain SVG without a chart library. It fits its container, can be explored with a pointer or the arrow keys, and always comes with a written summary and a View as table switch that shows the same numbers.

components.name: Chat
components.description: A whole conversation with an assistant: the messages, a box to write in, and the stop and jump-to-latest controls. It shows what you give it and reports what the person does; it never calls a model.

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Lets the user turn a single option on or off, with an optional indeterminate state.

components.name: Citation
components.description: A small numbered marker, like [1], inside a reply that jumps to the source it refers to.

components.name: Collapsible
components.description: One region that opens and closes under a trigger, for detail most people do not need at first. For a stack of related sections, use Accordion.

components.name: Combobox
components.description: Text input that filters a list of options as you type. Supports multi-select tags, async loading and long, virtualized lists.

components.name: CommandPalette
components.description: A search box in a dialog that finds and runs commands, jumps to pages and triggers actions from the keyboard. Opens with Ctrl or Cmd + K. Use CommandGroup and CommandItem for the results.

components.name: CustomerTable
components.description: A ready-to-use customer list: search, filters, sorting, pages, CSV export, loading rows, an empty state, an error with retry, cards on a phone, and totals with a chart above that follow the filters. Give it customers and it works.

components.name: DashboardPage
components.description: One page of a dashboard: a title with its actions, a row of key numbers, then your content. It sits inside DashboardShell but works anywhere. The title is the page's h1.

components.name: DashboardShell
components.description: The frame of a dashboard or admin app: a sidebar of navigation that folds down to icons, a top bar with search and actions, an account menu, and the page. On a phone, or in any narrow space, the sidebar becomes a menu that slides in.

components.name: DataGrid
components.description: A fast, accessible data grid for thousands of rows: sorting, filtering, grouping, editing, copy and paste, export and server-side data. Columns are TanStack Table column definitions.

components.name: DatePicker
components.description: Date field with a calendar popover. Typing and picking both work, in the user's locale.

components.name: DateRangePicker
components.description: Start and end date fields with a two-month calendar and optional presets like 'Last 7 days'.

components.name: Dialog
components.description: Modal window that asks for focus, such as a confirmation or a short form. Open it with DialogTrigger.

components.name: EmptyState
components.description: What to show when a list, table or page has nothing in it yet: a short explanation and the next step.

components.name: ErrorState
components.description: What to show when a page or a panel could not be shown: a failed load, or a 404, 403 or 500 screen, with what happened and how to go on.

components.name: ErrorSummary
components.description: The list of problems at the top of a Form after a failed submit. Focus moves to it and each item takes the person to its field. It shows nothing until a submit has failed and goes away when everything is fixed.

components.name: FieldArray
components.description: Repeating rows of fields inside a Form, such as invoice lines or team members. Add, remove, move up or down and insert are all buttons, so the keyboard does everything; focus lands somewhere sensible and a polite message says what changed. The rows contents and any totals are yours.

components.name: FileUpload
components.description: A drop zone and button for choosing files, with type, size and count limits and a list of the chosen files you can remove from. The component picks the files; you upload them.

components.name: Form
components.description: A form that holds the values, runs your validators or a schema, and exposes its progress as an action state (idle, pending, success, error). Fields connect by name and the inputs already link label, help text and error. It never fetches or saves anything: your onSubmit does.

components.name: GeneratedChart
components.description: A bar or line chart an assistant produced, drawn without a chart library, always with a written summary and a View as table switch that shows the same numbers as a table.

components.name: GeneratedTable
components.description: A table an assistant produced, shown as a real sortable table with a title and summary, numbers aligned, long results cut to a few rows, and a CSV download.

components.name: GradientButton
components.description: A button with a colour that travels around its edge. The label sits on the normal button surface, so its contrast is the plain Button's. Builds on Button.

components.name: GradientText
components.description: Text filled with a gradient that keeps flowing, for a short headline or a highlighted word. The words stay real text.

components.name: InputOTP
components.description: One-time code input for verification and two-factor sign in. One real input holds the code and drawn cells show it, so paste, autofill from SMS and screen readers all work.

components.name: Kbd
components.description: Shows a keyboard key or shortcut, like Ctrl or ⌘K, in a keycap style. Not interactive.

components.name: Menu
components.description: A list of actions or options that opens from a button, like a More (…) or Account menu. Use with MenuTrigger and MenuItem.

components.name: Message
components.description: One message in a conversation, from you or the assistant. It renders each part in order with the right component: text as formatted markdown, tool calls as activity, tables and charts as real components, sources at the end.

components.name: NumberField
components.description: A text field for numbers, with increment and decrement buttons, keyboard stepping, and locale-aware formatting for decimals, currency, units and percentages.

components.name: PageHeader
components.description: The top of a page: breadcrumbs, a title with badges, a description, actions on the right and tabs underneath. Every part is optional except the title.

components.name: Pagination
components.description: Page numbers with previous and next buttons, for content split across pages. Long ranges collapse to the first page, the last page, and the pages around the current one.

components.name: Popover
components.description: Non-modal panel anchored to a trigger, for extra controls or details. Open it with DialogTrigger.

components.name: Progress
components.description: A bar showing how far along a task is, or that something is working when the amount is unknown.

components.name: PromptInput
components.description: The message box of a chat: one rounded bar with a + menu on the left, the text in the middle, and your own controls, a microphone and Send on the right. Added files show above the text. You get only the buttons you ask for.

components.name: PulseButton
components.description: A button with a soft ring that keeps radiating out, to draw the eye to the one action that matters now. Builds on Button.

components.name: RadioGroup
components.description: Lets the user pick exactly one option from a small, visible set. Use with Radio children.

components.name: Response
components.description: Shows an assistant's reply as formatted text: headings, lists, tables, code, links and source markers. It is safe for text you do not control and for text that is still arriving.

components.name: RevealButton
components.description: A button that opens an arrow beside its label when you hover or focus it, to suggest "go". Only a transition, so there is nothing to pause. Builds on Button.

components.name: RippleButton
components.description: A button that sends a ripple out from where you pressed it, or from its centre when pressed with the keyboard. Builds on Button.

components.name: Ripple
components.description: Concentric rings that swell outward from the centre, as a calm backdrop behind a heading or a call to action. Content goes in front of the rings.

components.name: SectionHeader
components.description: The heading of a section inside a page, for a card or a table: a title, a description and actions on the right.

components.name: SegmentedControl
components.description: A row of connected buttons where exactly one option is chosen, for switching a view or a setting with two to five choices. Use SegmentedControlItem for each option.

components.name: Select
components.description: Picks one option from a list shown in a popover. Use with SelectItem children.

components.name: Separator
components.description: A thin line that divides content, horizontal or vertical, with an optional label in the middle such as "or".

components.name: Sheet
components.description: A modal panel that slides in from the edge of the screen, for filters, details or navigation on small screens. Open it with DialogTrigger.

components.name: ShimmerButton
components.description: A button with a soft band of light that crosses its surface now and then, for one standout action. Builds on Button, so focus, disabled and loading work the same.

components.name: ShineBorder
components.description: A band of colour that slides steadily along a border, so the edge seems to catch the light. Wrap a card or a field.

components.name: ShuttleBorder
components.description: A point of light that runs around the edge of whatever is inside, like the shuttle of a loom crossing the threads. Wrap a card, an input or a button; give it your radius and background.

components.name: Sidebar
components.description: A sidebar of navigation: the team or product name at the top, grouped links with sub-items and badges, an optional footer, and the signed-in person at the bottom. It can fold down to icons, and comes in four looks. It is only the panel; DashboardShell adds the top bar and the phone menu.

components.name: Skeleton
components.description: A grey placeholder shaped like the content that is loading, so the page doesn't jump when it arrives.

components.name: Slider
components.description: Picks a number, or a range with two thumbs, by dragging along a track. Shows the formatted value.

components.name: Sources
components.description: The numbered list of sources a reply drew on, with title, site and a short excerpt. Each entry is where a Citation marker lands.

components.name: Sparkline
components.description: A tiny line or bar graphic that shows the shape of a trend, without axes. Decoration unless it has a label.

components.name: Stat
components.description: A key number with its label and context: a value, an optional change over time and an optional small trend graphic. Unframed: place it in a Card or a grid.

components.name: Steps
components.description: Shows where someone is in a multi-step process, such as checkout or setup: done, current and upcoming steps. It displays progress; you control the steps and buttons.

components.name: Switch
components.description: Turns a setting on or off, taking effect immediately.

components.name: Table
components.description: A simple, accessible table for a small number of rows: optional sorting and row selection. Build it from TableHeader, TableColumn, TableBody, TableRow and TableCell. For thousands of rows, filtering, editing or grouping, use DataGrid.

components.name: Tabs
components.description: Switches between related panels of content in the same place. Use with TabList, Tab and TabPanel.

components.name: TagInput
components.description: A text field that turns what you type into removable tags when you press Enter or comma: for keywords, recipients and labels.

components.name: TextField
components.description: Single-line or multi-line text input with a label, help text and error message.

components.name: TextShimmer
components.description: Text with a band of light sweeping across it, for a loading message or a quiet accent. The words stay real text: selectable and read as normal.

components.name: TimeField
components.description: A field for a time of day, with separate hour, minute and (optional) second segments that follow the visitor's locale and 12 or 24 hour clock.

components.name: Toast
components.description: Brief, non-blocking message about the result of an action. Render ToastRegion once and call toast().

components.name: ToggleButton
components.description: A button that stays pressed until pressed again, for turning a mode on or off, like Bold or Mute. Group several with ToggleButtonGroup for single or multiple choice.

components.name: ToolCall
components.description: One thing the assistant did, such as searching or running a query: its name, where it is (waiting, running, needs approval, done, failed), how long it took, and on request what went in and out.

components.name: Tooltip
components.description: Short text label shown on hover or keyboard focus. Wrap the trigger and tooltip in TooltipTrigger.

components.name: Tree
components.description: An expandable hierarchy such as folders and files or a nested menu, with keyboard navigation and optional selection. Build it from nested TreeItem elements.
